subject: English
passage: In 2018, architect Lenka Dvorak designed 75 green roofs, vegetated building tops engineered to insulate structures and reduce energy consumption, across commercial districts in Phoenix, Arizona. By lowering the ambient temperature in surrounding urban areas, ______
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: the reduction of both energy costs and the resulting carbon emissions has been achieved by green roofs.
choices.B: the green roofs' reduction of both energy costs and the resulting carbon emissions has been achieved.
choices.C: the green roofs have reduced both energy costs and the resulting carbon emissions.
choices.D: both energy costs and the resulting carbon emissions have been reduced by green roofs.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-modifier placement. This choice makes the noun phrase "the green roofs" the subject of the sentence and places it immediately after the modifying phrase "By lowering…areas." In doing so, this choice clearly establishes that the green roofs—and not another noun in the sentence—are lowering ambient temperature in surrounding urban areas.
